Pat (procurement - finservco): Hi Redwood team — procurement here. For the pilot we need: a SOC 2 cover summary, ISO control mapping, and a signed pen-test attestation. Also: does reserved/dedicated pricing change for an on-prem/private deployment?
Maya (sales): Thanks Pat. We can provide redacted SOC2 excerpts and an ISO mapping. Pen-test attestation we can sign. Pricing yes — private/on-prem has a platform & install component.
Jon (acct exec): Quick Q: is the control plane customer-managed or do you want Redwood to run it in your VPC? That affects cost.
Pat (procurement - finservco): We need fully customer-hosted control plane (air-gapped).
Priya (solutions): Got it. For air-gapped we have a private package: one-time install fee + platform fee + reserved capacity min term. For a small POC (5 sessions) estimate below.
Evan (security): Artifact note: we'll supply a redacted SOC2 summary PDF, SOC2 bridge letter, ISO control mapping CSV, and a pen-test attestation PDF. We can't share raw vendor pen-test reports unless legally approved.
Samir (legal): I can sign the standard pen-test attestation template. Please upload their template and any custom clauses for review.
Pat (procurement - finservco): Uploading template and control list to presigned link now. Also need a short deployment timeline for procurement.
deploy-bot: presigned link created: https://s3-presigned.example.com/finserv/poc_upload.zip (expires 72h)
Priya (solutions): Timeline: 2 weeks scheduling/on-site setup, 1 week validation = ~3 weeks. Install requires network diagram + allowlist from your infra.
Jon (acct exec): Pricing estimate for POC (preliminary): platform fee (one-time) "$3,800", install "$1,500", monthly reserved "$2,200" (1-node minimal). I'll confirm with finance.
Pat (procurement - finservco): Procurement will need those as separate line items in a quote. Also confirm KMS options (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed).
Evan (security): KMS: for on-prem we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-HSM) — requires key-access docs and adds small ops surcharge. We'll outline options in the artifact bundle.
Maya (sales): Action items: Pat upload template + control list. Samir/Evan review and return signed attestation + SOC excerpts within 3 business days for standard template. Jon to post formal quote. Priya to share install checklist.
Pat (procurement - finservco): Uploaded to link. Procurement expects PO in 12 business days after receiving signed attestation + quote.
Samir (legal): Reviewing template now. Expect sign within 48–72h if no custom redlines.
Priya (solutions): Install checklist summary: network diagram, firewall allowlist, VPN creds, bastion user, and maintenance window. Will post checklist doc here.
Evan (security): Uploading SOC2 summary + ISO mapping and draft attestation to presigned link when ready.
Jon (acct exec): Finance confirmed numbers, pulling formal quote PDF and will attach here by EOD.
Maya (sales): Thanks — will follow up once signed attestation and quote are in. :thumbsup:
